title: performance-ceiling-analysis
summary: Estimate optimization headroom before modifying an inference system. Produces a three-level ceiling model (analytical, empirical component, end-to-end) and a prioritized measurement plan. Use when asked whether a target speedup is worth pursuing, or to identify the binding bottleneck.
